custody_policy: Secret values remain outside the public repository. This registry stores only non-secret binding metadata and provider expectations.

bindings.custody: CrownThrive ThriveBase Supabase Vault + GitHub protected secret stores
bindings.required_capability: GitHub Projects v2 create/read/write for the crownthrive1 user-owned project plus repository Issues/Pull Requests access required by PentaPM
bindings.last_provider_error_class: Resource not accessible by personal access token
bindings.fallback: repository GITHUB_TOKEN for repository-scoped metadata only
bindings.fallback_limit: Repository GITHUB_TOKEN may reconcile milestones, issue/PR metadata and Development linkage but is not authoritative for user-owned Projects v2.
bindings.exposure_policy: Never commit, log, print, echo, serialize, or place token values in source, issues, receipts, artifacts, or public records.
bindings.verification_policy: Provider readback must prove Projects v2 authority before PentaPM clears projects_v2_provider_authority HOLD.
